_comment: Discern Expert (EKS) style rule definitions. Each rule has EVOKE (what triggers it), LOGIC (conditions) and ACTION (what it would do). Rules are replayed against history by src/discern_rules.py in SILENT mode: logic is evaluated and logged to EKS_MODULE_AUDIT, no alert is shown. That is how alert volume and accuracy are measured before a rule is turned on.

logic.template: same orderable already ordered on this encounter within N minutes, prior order not cancelled at sign time

rules.action: Interruptive alert to ordering provider: 'Same test ordered @MIN min ago on this visit' - options: Cancel new order / Keep (reason required)

rules.evoke: TIMER: 30 minutes after a lab result verifies with normalcy = CRITICAL

logic.template: no 'Critical Result Notification' documented on the encounter since the result verified

rules.action: Message to charge nurse pool of the patient's unit + task 'Call critical result'
